app_tagline: [बर'/बड़ो] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [बर'/बड़ो] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [बर'/बड़ो] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [बर'/बड़ो] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [बर'/बड़ो] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [बर'/बड़ो] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [बर'/बड़ो] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [बर'/बड़ो] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [बर'/बड़ो] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [बर'/बड़ो] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [बर'/बड़ो] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [बर'/बड़ो] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [बर'/बड़ो] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [बर'/बड़ो] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [बर'/बड़ो] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [बर'/बड़ो] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [बर'/बड़ो] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [बर'/बड़ो] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [बर'/बड़ो] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [बर'/बड़ो] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [बर'/बड़ो] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [बर'/बड़ो] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [बर'/बड़ो] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [बर'/बड़ो] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [बर'/बड़ो] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [बर'/बड़ो] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [बर'/बड़ो] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [बर'/बड़ो] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [बर'/बड़ो] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [brx] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [brx] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [brx] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [brx] Type or speak your question for the helper...
